_comment: Seed list for a property's competitor watchlist, matched case-insensitively as a substring against Google Hotels result names. Only applied on FIRST read — once a watchlist exists in the store it is edited in the UI (Competitors → watchlist), and changes here will not reach it. Names only have to match once: the collector then pins each hotel by its stable google_hotels property_token, so drift in how Google phrases a name stops mattering. Keep them short anyway, so the first match lands.
